messages:
maria: Heads-up: I pushed a draft relnotes PR for v0.9.4 (docs/relnotes) — needs SDK snippet sweep, migration steps for embed streaming removal, and a short Known Issues block. Can folks review before EOD?
sam: I can scan snippets. Do we still call out embed streaming removal explicitly?
maria: yes, brief blurb + concrete migration code. Also update Go + Python to the new sync embed API (client.embed).
alex: Ill handle Python snippets. What does the new response look like?
liz: from the runtime test harness: ```python
resp = client.embed(model='rwd-mini-embed-1', input='doc')
print(resp['embedding'][:8])
```  that's the shape. Remove streaming examples.
sam: Go snippets updated in branch, pushed commit 5f3a. docs-bot: CI status?
docs-bot: CI: docs-lint passed; snippet-tests failed: 2 failures in sdk-snippets/test_embed.py
maria: @liz can you run snippet-tests locally? Might be token/timeouts.
liz: running now. Fail was harness timeout at 2s; bumping to 10s fixed it locally. Pushing patch for snippet-tests timeout.
alex: found broken anchor in migration guide (/v0.8/embeds -> 404). Fixed in PR.
maria: Great. Draft Known Issue to include: "embed-streaming deprecation: streaming endpoint removed 2026-04-01; calls to client.embed_stream return 410. Use client.embed or websocket proxy if you need streamed tokens (see migration guide)."
sam: Recommend adding a graceful fallback snippet to ease upgrades.
maria: Good call, add: ```js
try { await client.embed_stream(...) } catch (e) { if (e.status === 410) { await client.embed(...); } else { throw e; } }
```
liz: internal note for Dedicated customers: older runtimes will be auto-migrated; include enterprise contact enterprise-support@redwood.ai
sam: timeline: want this merged by 17:00 PT. I'll +1 if tests are green.
maria: tagging release lead @alex for wording sign-off.
alex: sign-off pending docs-bot green.
docs-bot: CI: all checks passed. Deploy preview: https://deploy-preview.prod.redwood.ai/rc/0.9.4/docs-relnotes
maria: Preview looks good. Small nit: fix hyphenation for "KV cache" paragraph.
sam: fixed and pushed.
liz: ran linkcheck: replaced external 302ing link https://old.example.com/api -> https://docs.example.com/new-api
maria: final: merging at 16:45 PT. Thanks everyone :tada:
sam: :thumbsup:
